title: S3, proving the fix
summary: Simulated. The installer replaces panel 4, extends the fence and marks the work complete. A reviewer who did not install it re-tests it on a phone: the saved view and both routes pass. The pass returns, valid for 12 months, and the audit trail shows every step.
